question: Over the 24 months of 2024 and 2025, which product category has the steepest upward trend in monthly units sold in completed orders? Give the category and the slope of a least-squares line, in units per month.

sql_attempts.sql:
WITH monthly_category_sales AS (,
  SELECT,
    p.category,
    strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month_str,
    CAST(SUBSTR(strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date), 1, 4) AS INTEGER) * 12 + CAST(SUBSTR(strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date), 6, 2) AS INTEGER) AS m_idx,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS units
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY p.category, month_str
),
regressions AS (
  SELECT
    category,
    (
      COUNT(*) * SUM(m_idx * units) - SUM(m_idx) * SUM(units)
    ) / (
      COUNT(*) * SUM(m_idx * m_idx) - SUM(m_idx) * SUM(m_idx)
    ) AS slope
  FROM monthly_category_sales
  GROUP BY category
)
SELECT category, slope
FROM regressions
ORDER BY slope DESC
LIMIT 1
